programme.title: SUPA STRIKAS
programme.desc: Setiap kali supa strikas main bola, pasti seru sekali! mereka harus melawan tim-tim lain yang kadang curang atau punya rahasia. Shakes dan teman-temannya harus pintar memecahkan misteri dan bekerja sama. Lewat cerita supa strikas, kita jadi tahu kalau main bola itu bukan cuma tentang menang, tapi juga tentang kerja sama tim yang baik, jadi anak yang jujur, dan tidak mudah menyerah. mereka berkeliling dunia, bertemu banyak teman baru, dan belajar jadi lebih baik setiap harinya.

programme.desc: After losing her mother at a young age, Dou Zhao became deeply disillusioned with love and family due to the upheavals and hardships she faced. To protect herself and her family estate, she contended with her stepmother and chose to live in a remote village, focusing on her studies to become self-reliant. Aoko (Matsui Rena), who grew up there and works as a porcelain painter, enjoys a quiet life until Tatsuki (Ichinose Hayate), a solitary potter, arrives from Finland. When he declares that his pottery needs no painted decoration, Aoko feels he is rejecting not only her work but her entire community. Yet she gradually finds herself drawn to the beauty of his creations.

programme.title: Ninja Art Of Heart, Popomaru!
programme.desc: A fun ninja drama where parents and children can explore emotional growth together! The story follows Shinobi, an elementary school ninja, as she teams up with Popomaru -- the playful spirit of emotions -- to learn a creative way of understanding feelings and building positive relationships with those around her. Join her on an exciting journey to discover how to handle emotions with skill and joy!

Program ini menggabungkan eksperimen praktis, wawancara dengan ilmuwan, dan visualisasi canggih untuk menjelaskan fenomena ilmiah dengan cara yang mudah dipahami oleh penonton umum.

programme.title: Brothers In Arms
programme.desc: Set in the Sengoku era, this drama follows Toyotomi brothers' rise from obscurity to unify Japan. Through Hidenaga's eyes, it reveals ambition, loyalty, and the bond that shaped a nation's destiny.

programme.title: Ukiyoe Edo-Life
programme.desc: Centuries ago, Tokyo was known as Edo. More than a million people enjoyed life in this small but abundant city. They live on in ukiyo-e woodblock prints. Each episode is a deep dive into a single print, and an exploration of the soul of Old Tokyo. We examine works by artists like Hokusai and Hiroshige not just for their aesthetic and historical value, but for the stories they tell of everyday life. That is how the people of Edo themselves enjoyed this mass-produced medium.

programme.title: Blossom
programme.desc: After losing her mother at a young age, Dou Zhao became deeply disillusioned with love and family due to the upheavals and hardships she faced. To protect herself and her family estate, she contended with her stepmother and chose to live in a remote village, focusing on her studies to become self-reliant. One stormy night, Dou Zhao encountered Song Mo, disguised as a merchant, at the village. Using her wit, she helped him protect the orphaned descendant of Duke Dingguo, who had been honored for his achievements in quelling bandits. This incident intertwined their fates.

There, twins Jade and Mica find their world turned upside down when their explorer parents entrust them with three mysterious Marsupilami eggs. Once they hatch, the siblings must get creative to keep their new friends hidden after all, no one knows these energetic creatures exist, and predators could be lurking around every corner.

programme.title: The Marsupilamis
programme.desc: Marsupilami yang legendaris meninggalkan hutan belantara Palombia dan pindah ke tempat yang lebih liar lagi: kota. Di sana, si kembar Jade dan Mica mendapati dunia mereka terbalik ketika orang tua mereka yang seorang penjelajah mempercayakan tiga telur Marsupilami misterius kepada mereka. Setelah menetas, kedua saudara ini harus kreatif untuk menyembunyikan teman-teman baru mereka—lagipula, tidak ada yang tahu keberadaan makhluk-makhluk energik ini, dan predator bisa saja mengintai di setiap sudut.

programme.title: Cinta Suci
programme.desc: Suci (Irish Bella), who finds herself in a difficult situation, is forced to marry Marcel (Ammar Zoni) because she desperately needs money to pay for the surgeries of her husband and son, Aditya (Jonas Rivanno) and Ronny (Radja Nasution), to save their lives. Meanwhile, Monica (Asmirandah) deeply hates Suci because she believes Suci forced Marcel into marrying her against his will.

programme.title: Cinta Suci
programme.desc: Suci (Irish Bella) yang terjerat masalah harus menikahi Marcel (Ammar Zoni), karena ia sangat membutuhkan uang untuk biaya operasi suami dan anak nya, yaitu Aditya (Jonas Rivanno) dan Ronny (Radja Nasution) agar mereka berdua tetap hidup. Sedangkan di sisi lain, Monica (Asmirandah) sangat membenci Suci karena mengira Suci sudah membuat Marcel menikah terpaksa dengan nya.

programme.title: Liputan 6 Siang (L)

programme.title: Samudra Cinta
programme.desc: The story begins in a simple house, Rusdi with his wife Novi and their three children: Andra, Novan and Vina are chatting in the living room while watching television. Because Vina couldn't sleep, Novi asked Rusdi to turn off the TV. It was then, they just heard the sound of a baby crying that seemed to come from the front of the house. Curious Rusdi and Novi finally put Vina in the baby box and stepped outside to check on the baby. Novi and Rusdi checked to the front and were very surprised to find Lila holding a baby. Lila begs Rusdi to take care of her flesh and blood, which is named Cinta.

programme.title: Samudra Cinta
programme.desc: Cerita bermula di sebuah rumah sederhana. Rusdi bersama istrinya, Novi, dan ketiga anak mereka, Andra, Novan, dan Vina, sedang berbincang di ruang tamu sambil menonton televisi. Karena Vina tidak bisa tidur, Novi meminta Rusdi mematikan televisi. Saat itulah, mereka mendengar suara tangisan bayi yang seolah berasal dari depan rumah. Karena penasaran, Rusdi dan Novi akhirnya menidurkan Vina di dalam boks bayi, lalu keluar untuk memeriksa keadaan. Saat sampai di depan rumah, Novi dan Rusdi sangat terkejut melihat Lila sedang menggendong seorang bayi. Lila memohon kepada Rusdi untuk merawat anak kandungnya yang bernama Cinta.

programme.title: Cinta Seluas Samudra
programme.desc: Maya is trapped in a fake marriage with Andrian, the heir to a business empire who gradually falls in love with her. However, Hana’s revenge leads Maya to fall into an abyss and she is presumed dead. When Maya is revealed to be alive and in Roni’s hands, a conspiracy makes her believe that Andrian has betrayed her.

programme.title: Cinta Seluas Samudra
programme.desc: Maya terjebak dalam pernikahan palsu dengan Andrian, pewaris konglomerat yang perlahan jatuh cinta padanya. Namun, dendam Hana membawa Maya ke jurang dan membuatnya dinyatakan tewas. Saat Maya ternyata masih hidup dan berada di tangan Roni, sebuah konspirasi membuatnya percaya bahwa Andrian telah mengkhianatinya.

programme.title: Wajah Cinta Yang Lain
programme.desc: A single act of betrayal changes Asti's life forever. Stripped of her face, her family, and the life she once believed in, she rises with a new identity to uncover the conspiracy that destroyed everything she held dear. As each hidden truth comes to light, Asti must choose between seeking revenge and fighting for the future of her child—the only reason she continues to live.

programme.title: Wajah Cinta Yang Lain

programme.title: JAD ET SES SOEURS
programme.desc: Jad et ses soeurs mengisahkan kehidupan sehari-hari Jad bersama dua saudara kembarnya, Ranya dan Syrine. Dalam setiap episode, mereka menghadapi berbagai situasi yang dekat dengan dunia anak-anak, mulai dari kegiatan sekolah, permainan bersama teman, perjalanan keluarga, hingga tantangan kecil yang mengajarkan nilai-nilai kehidupan. programme.title: COMPOSTMAN ET MOI
programme.desc: Compostman et Moi is a documentary that explores the growing movement toward sustainable living through the work of Florian Bonnet, better known as "Compostman." Passionate about reducing food waste and improving urban ecology, he travels across communities to encourage composting as an accessible solution for transforming organic waste into valuable natural resources. Along the way, the film highlights environmental challenges, community initiatives, and the positive impact that individual actions can have on building a more sustainable future.

programme.title: COMPOSTMAN ET MOI
programme.desc: Compostman et Moi adalah dokumenter yang mengisahkan perjalanan Florian Bonnet, seorang aktivis lingkungan yang dikenal dengan julukan "Compostman". Dengan semangat mengurangi limbah makanan dan meningkatkan kesadaran akan pentingnya pengelolaan sampah organik, ia berkeliling menemui berbagai komunitas untuk memperkenalkan manfaat pengomposan. Melalui kisah-kisah inspiratif, inisiatif masyarakat, dan penjelasan mengenai dampak positif pengomposan terhadap lingkungan, dokumenter ini menunjukkan bagaimana tindakan sederhana sehari-hari dapat membantu mengurangi sampah, memperbaiki kualitas tanah, dan mendukung gaya hidup yang lebih ramah lingkungan.

programme.title: COMPOSTMAN ET MOI
programme.desc: Compostman et Moi is a documentary that explores the growing movement toward sustainable living through the work of Florian Bonnet, better known as "Compostman." Passionate about reducing food waste and improving urban ecology, he travels across communities to encourage composting as an accessible solution for transforming organic waste into valuable natural resources. Along the way, the film highlights environmental challenges, community initiatives, and the positive impact that individual actions can have on building a more sustainable future.

programme.title: COMPOSTMAN ET MOI
programme.desc: Compostman et Moi adalah dokumenter yang mengisahkan perjalanan Florian Bonnet, seorang aktivis lingkungan yang dikenal dengan julukan "Compostman". Dengan semangat mengurangi limbah makanan dan meningkatkan kesadaran akan pentingnya pengelolaan sampah organik, ia berkeliling menemui berbagai komunitas untuk memperkenalkan manfaat pengomposan. Melalui kisah-kisah inspiratif, inisiatif masyarakat, dan penjelasan mengenai dampak positif pengomposan terhadap lingkungan, dokumenter ini menunjukkan bagaimana tindakan sederhana sehari-hari dapat membantu mengurangi sampah, memperbaiki kualitas tanah, dan mendukung gaya hidup yang lebih ramah lingkungan.

programme.desc: Sepasang suami istri yang menerima penyelesaian perceraian kehilangan ingatan mereka karena sebuah kecelakaan. Mereka jatuh cinta lagi, sehingga keluarga mereka berusaha mengembalikan ingatan mereka untuk menyelesaikan perceraian.

programme.title: Whispering Corridors 6 (tvN Movies)
programme.desc: Eun Hee returns to her old high school as vice principal. When strange sounds and a ghostly figure appear in a closed washroom, she realizes the mystery is connected to her past and her return to the school.

programme.title: Whispering Corridors 6 (tvN Movies)
programme.desc: Eun Hee kembali ke sekolah lamanya sebagai wakil kepala sekolah. Saat suara aneh dan sosok hantu muncul di toilet yang ditutup, ia menyadari misteri itu berkaitan dengan masa lalunya dan alasan ia kembali ke sekolah tersebut.

programme.title: Drive
programme.desc: Yoo-Na (Park Ju-Hyun) is a popular YouTuber with over 700,000 subscribers. She enjoys her life, but, one night, she is kidnapped by an unidentified person. The kidnapper orders her to earn 650 million won through a one hour broadcast.

programme.title: Kingmaker
programme.desc: A politician met a talented campaign strategist who helped him in becoming the strongest presidential election candidate. Yet conflicts deepen as the he disagrees with the latter on his ideologies.

programme.title: Kingmaker
programme.desc: Film ini didasarkan pada kisah anekdotal tentang hubungan kerja antara Kim Dae-jung dan ahli strategi politiknya, Uhm Chang-rok. Seo Chang-dae adalah seorang ahli strategi politik yang mengutamakan kemenangan di atas segalanya, sedangkan Kim Woon-beom adalah seorang politisi dengan ambisi menjadi presiden terkemuka. Namun, konflik internal dalam kampanye muncul saat Seo Chang Dae mendesak Kim Woon Bum untuk melakukan beberapa taktik curang.

programme.title: Decibel
programme.desc: A former navy commander receives a threatening call who claims to blow up a stadium with a sound-responsive bomb. He must face the secret he left buried in the deep sea to track this terrorist down.

programme.title: Decibel
programme.desc: Seorang mantan komandan angkatan laut menerima panggilan telepon dari pria tak dikenal yang menyatakan telah memasang bom di lokasi yang dipenuhi orang. Bom tersebut adalah "bom suara" yang akan meledak saat suara sekitar melebihi 100 desibel. Mantan komandan angkatan laut pun berusaha mati-matian menghentikan serangan teror tersebut.

programme.title: Miracle In Cell No. 7
programme.desc: A story about the love between a mentally-ill father and his lovingly adorable daughter.

programme.title: Miracle In Cell No. 7
programme.desc: Sebuah kisah tentang cinta antara seorang ayah yang sakit jiwa dan putrinya yang menggemaskan.

programme.title: Gyeong-ah's Daughter
programme.desc: Gyeong Ah works as a caregiver and lives alone. The only one she can rely on is her daughter, Yeon Soo, but they barely meet after Yeon Soo moved out. One night, Gyeong Ah receives a shocking message from a stranger.

programme.title: Gyeong-ah's Daughter
programme.desc: Gyeong Ah works as a caregiver and lives alone. The only one she can rely on is her daughter, Yeon Soo, but they barely meet after Yeon Soo moved out. One night, Gyeong Ah receives a shocking message from a stranger.

programme.title: Concrete Utopia
programme.desc: Seoul has laid in ruin after an earthquake, leaving one single apartment remains standing. The apartment's resident representative strives to protect residents from outsiders.

programme.title: Concrete Utopia
programme.desc: Kota Seoul, yang telah hancur setelah gempa bumi, menyisakan satu apartemen yang masih berdiri. Perwakilan penghuni apartemen berusaha keras untuk melindungi penghuni lainnya dari orang luar.

programme.title: The Priests
programme.desc: Two priests have to find out if a young girl was attacked by an evil spirit or human molester in order to save her life.

programme.title: The Exclusive: Devil's Tattoo
programme.desc: An unsuccessful journalist becomes a star in the media after he wrote an article about the memo of an unknown serial killer. As he learns that the memo was just part of a novel, he decides to cover up everything.

programme.title: Whispering Corridors 6
programme.desc: Eun Hee returns to her old high school as vice principal. When strange sounds and a ghostly figure appear in a closed washroom, she realizes the mystery is connected to her past and her return to the school.

programme.title: Whispering Corridors 6
programme.desc: Eun Hee kembali ke sekolah lamanya sebagai wakil kepala sekolah. Saat suara aneh dan sosok hantu muncul di toilet yang ditutup, ia menyadari misteri itu berkaitan dengan masa lalunya dan alasan ia kembali ke sekolah tersebut.

programme.title: The Unfair (tvN Movies)
programme.desc: Residents, who are evicted from their homes in a designated urban renewal, demonstrate against their removal. The police arrive and attempt to end the demonstration. Death happen that lead to the bigger problem.

programme.title: The Unfair (tvN Movies)
programme.desc: Warga yang digusur dari rumah mereka di kawasan pembaruan kota yang telah ditentukan, berdemonstrasi menentang penggusuran tersebut. Polisi tiba dan berusaha mengakhiri demonstrasi. Namun, kematian terjadi dan menyebabkan masalah yang lebih besar.

programme.title: Countdown (tvN Movies)
programme.desc: A debt collector has liver cancer and has to get a liver transplant in 10 days. A seductive swindler agrees to donate her liver only if he tracks down the man who put her in prison.

programme.title: Countdown (tvN Movies)
programme.desc: Seorang penagih utang menderita kanker hati dan harus mendapatkan transplantasi hati dalam sepuluh hari. Seorang penipu bersedia mendonorkan hatinya jika ia bisa melacak pria yang memasukkannya ke dalam penjara.

programme.title: The Roundup: Punishment (tvN Movies)
programme.desc: Detective Ma Seok-do joins the Cyber Investigation Team to nab Baek Chang-ki, a former mercenary and the head of an online gambling organization.

programme.title: The Roundup: Punishment (tvN Movies)
programme.desc: Detektif Ma Seok-do bergabung dengan Tim Investigasi Cyber ​​untuk menangkap Baek Chang-ki, mantan tentara bayaran dan kepala organisasi perjudian daring.

programme.title: The Ghost Game
programme.desc: A mystery horror film that depicts what happens when Ja-yeong, who has a secret from her past, and her school friends perform a necromancy ritual to summon ghosts.

programme.title: Heartman: Rock And Love
programme.desc: Follows a single father who has to keep his daughter a secret from his first love from high school, who he meets again by chance, but who he discovers has no interest in dating anyone with children.

programme.title: Heartman: Rock And Love
programme.desc: Mengisahkan seorang ayah tunggal yang harus menyembunyikan keberadaan putrinya dari cinta pertamanya saat SMA. Mereka bertemu kembali secara tidak sengaja, tetapi ia mengetahui bahwa wanita tersebut tidak tertarik menjalin hubungan dengan pria yang sudah memiliki anak.

programme.title: The Favor
programme.desc: An occult film about a family's struggle to escape a terrible curse given to them in exchange for a desperately desired miracle.

programme.title: The Favor
programme.desc: Sebuah film okultisme tentang perjuangan sebuah keluarga untuk melepaskan diri dari kutukan mengerikan yang diberikan kepada mereka sebagai imbalan atas sebuah mukjizat yang sangat mereka dambakan.

programme.title: A Taxi Driver
programme.desc: A widowed father and taxi driver who drives a German reporter from Seoul to Gwangju to cover the 1980 uprising, soon finds himself regretting his decision after being caught in the violence around him.

programme.title: The Childe
programme.desc: Marco, seorang petinju yang lahir dari ayah Korea dan ibu Filipina. Akibat kesulitan keuangan dan ibu yang sakit-sakitan, Marco memutuskan pergi ke Korea Selatan untuk mencari keberadaan sang ayah yang sejak kecil meninggalkannya. Setibanya di Korea Selatan, Marco mendadak menjadi buronan seorang pria misterius dan sekelompok orang jahat yang tak pernah berhenti mengejarnya.

programme.title: Iblis dalam Darah
programme.desc: Haruni feels something strange moving inside her—turns out, she’s possessed. Her sister Hanum meets Ahmad, a religious eye doctor, who links Haruni’s condition to a recent suicide case. Together, they dig for answers and fight the evil within.

programme.title: Iblis dalam Darah
programme.desc: Haruni merasakan ada yang aneh dalam tubuhnya—ia kesurupan. Saat adiknya, Hanum, berobat ke dokter mata bernama Ahmad, terungkap bahwa gangguan Haruni terkait kasus bunuh diri. Ahmad dan rekannya menyelidiki sambil mencoba menyelamatkan Haruni.

programme.title: Ikatan Cinta
programme.desc: Mengisahkan tentang dua bersaudara, Andin (kakak) dan Elsa (adik). Tanpa mereka sadari mencintai pria yang sama, Nino. programme.title: Liontin
programme.desc: Manda and Indy are sisters who love each other dearly. Their mother, Rianty, died while giving birth to Indy. Since then, Manda and Indy have lived as a family of three with their father, Indra. Manda has taken on the role of a mother to Indy. One day, their father began to fall ill and was admitted to the hospital. It turned out that Indra had leukemia.

programme.title: Liontin
programme.desc: Manda dan Indy adalah kakak beradik yang saling menyayangi. Ibu mereka, Rianty, meninggal saat melahirkan Indy. Sejak saat itu, Manda dan Indy hanya hidup bertiga bersama ayahnya, Indra. Manda berperan sebagai ibu bagi Indy. Suatu ketika ayah mereka mulai sakit sakitan dan masuk rumah sakit. Ternyata Indra mengidap leukemia.

programme.title: Bhoot Returns

programme.title: Bhoot Returns

Since then, Manda and Indy have lived as a family of three with their father, Indra. Manda has taken on the role of a mother to Indy. One day, their father began to fall ill and was admitted to the hospital. It turned out that Indra had leukemia.

programme.title: Liontin

Ternyata Indra mengidap leukemia.
